response.content:
1) A pack of gray and cream-colored wolves surrounds and bites several American bison. One bison initially struggles with them, while additional bison charge or run past, scattering the pack and kicking up snow.  
2) The scene is a bright, open, windswept snowy prairie with rolling drifts and sparse dry grass.  
3) In the final seconds, the wolves regroup around a bison lying on the snow. Several climb over it and appear to bite or feed while others stand or circle nearby.
